claims.claim: Four workers died after a steel-structure collapse at TSMC's Fab 22 construction site in Kaohsiung's Nanzih District.
claims.episode_span: Four workers have died after a steel structure collapsed during a hoisting and installation operation at Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co's Fab 22 site in Nanzih District, Kaohsiung
claims.source_title: Four dead after collapse at TSMC Kaohsiung site
claims.supporting_quote: Four workers have died in a workplace accident at a Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (TSMC) construction site in Kaohsiung, after the sole survivor succumbed to his injuries in a hospital this morning.

claims.claim: TSMC suspended similar steel structure work at all of its construction sites across Taiwan pending investigation.
claims.episode_span: suspended similar steel structure work at all of its construction sites across Taiwan pending investigation
claims.source_title: Taiwanese chipmaking giant halts work after four workers killed at factory site
claims.supporting_quote: "We and our construction contractor immediately suspended related construction work at the site, and we have also suspended similar steel structure work at all our construction sites across Taiwan pending our investigation," the company stated.

claims.claim: Preliminary investigations suggest bolts on a connecting plate of an outer steel structure on the third floor snapped.
claims.episode_span: bolts on a connecting plate of an outer steel structure on the third floor suddenly snapped
claims.source_title: Four dead after collapse at TSMC Kaohsiung site
claims.supporting_quote: Preliminary investigations suggest that bolts on a connecting plate of an outer steel structure on the third floor suddenly snapped, causing the workers and the heavy steel components to plunge to the ground, the bureau said.

claims.claim: Fab 22 is scheduled for 2-nanometer and more advanced process technologies, with Phase 4 construction set to be completed next year.
claims.episode_span: Fab 22 is scheduled to produce chips on 2-nanometer and more advanced process technologies, with construction of its Phase 4 fab set to be completed next year.
claims.source_title: Four dead after collapse at TSMC Kaohsiung site
claims.supporting_quote: TSMC's Fab 22 site is scheduled to produce chips using 2-nanometer and more advanced process technologies, with construction at its Phase 4 fab set to be completed next year.

claims.claim: Synaptics announced the Astra SR200 Series with custom DRAM scalable to hundreds of megabytes, Torq, Google Coral NPU, and the first Cortex-M85 and Cortex-M52 pairing.
claims.episode_span: The series uses the Synaptics Torq AI engine and the Coral NPU from Google Research, and Synaptics says it is the first pairing of an Arm Cortex-M85 with a Cortex-M52.
claims.source_title: (PR) Synaptics Announces Astra SR200 Multimodal Edge AI Processors with Google Coral NPU
claims.supporting_quote: The SR200 Series is powered by the Synaptics Torq AI engine, which brings a standards-based hardware architecture and unified developer experience featuring the Coral NPU from Google Research. It also comes with the industry's first pairing of the Arm Cortex -M85 and Cortex -M52.

claims.claim: The SR200 family offers up to 400 GOPS, 256 MB of custom DRAM, and tiers at 200, 300, and 400 GOPS.
claims.episode_span: EE Times, reporting from Synaptics Tech Day in San Jose on October 20, gives the family up to 400 GOPS of AI acceleration and 256 MB of custom DRAM
claims.source_title: Edge AI MCU Features Multimodal Compute, Tiered Memory
claims.supporting_quote: SR200, the industry’s first pairing of the Arm Cortex-M85 and the Cortex-M52 cores, combines high-performance compute with up to 400 GOPS of AI acceleration, 256 MB of custom DRAM, vision and audio capabilities, and hardware-rooted security.

claims.claim: Socionext is applying AI-driven design to physical design of a large-scale 3nm SoC with Cadence and expects up to 5X productivity gains.
claims.episode_span: The company is applying that flow to the physical design of a large-scale 3-nanometer SoC, using the Cadence InnoStack AI Super Agent
claims.source_title: Socionext Expands Agentic AI to Advanced, Large-Scale SoC Physical Design
claims.supporting_quote: “Socionext has already incorporated AI into front-end design activities and is applying AI-driven design to the physical design of a large-scale 3nm SoC,” said Hisato Yoshida, President and COO of Socionext.

claims.claim: Amazon pledged a €16 billion investment in Germany in 2027 including data centers and AI infrastructure.
claims.episode_span: Amazon has pledged a €16 billion investment in Germany in 2027.
claims.source_title: Amazon pledges €16bn investment in Germany in 2027
claims.supporting_quote: Includes expanding data centers and AI infrastructure, high-speed satellite Internet, and logistics expansion

claims.claim: Central Georgia EMC plans a 50-megawatt home battery deployment as hyperscale data centers seek to connect.
claims.episode_span: Central Georgia Electric Membership Corporation plans a 50-megawatt home-battery deployment.
claims.source_title: Georgia electric cooperative plans 50-MW home battery deployment
claims.supporting_quote: Central Georgia Electric Membership Corporation plans to use the batteries to reduce system peaks and energy costs as hyperscale data centers seek to connect to its grid.

claims.claim: OVHcloud said it has 110 megawatts of data-center capacity available.
claims.episode_span: OVHcloud has 110 megawatts of data-center capacity available to grow its customer base
claims.source_title: OVHcloud has 110MW of data center capacity up for grabs
claims.supporting_quote: Company reveals in its annual earnings call that it has capacity available to grow its customer base

claims.claim: Michael Dell said the memory shortage will get worse in 2027, Dell has about $95 billion of undelivered AI server orders, and he does not expect meaningful new memory supply until 2029 or 2030.
claims.episode_span: Michael Dell, Dell's chairman and chief executive, told The Wall Street Journal that the memory shortage will get worse next year
claims.source_title: Dell CEO Says the Memory Shortage Will Get Worse in 2027
claims.supporting_quote: Speaking with The Wall Street Journal , Dell's chairman and CEO said things will get worse next year, as the AI data center buildout keeps soaking up DRAM and HBM supply.

claims.claim: Micron is funding Indium Corporation to expand critical-minerals processing in Rome, New York, under a plan of up to $3 billion and alongside more than $250 billion of expected U.S. spend through 2035.
claims.episode_span: Micron has announced strategic funding so Indium Corporation can expand refining and high-purity materials manufacturing in Rome, New York
claims.source_title: Micron Invests in New York Critical Minerals Processing With Indium Corporation
claims.supporting_quote: The investment is part of Micron’s plan, announced in July, to invest up to $3 billion to strengthen the U.S. semiconductor supply-chain ecosystem and secure a reliable domestic supply of critical manufacturing materials.

claims.claim: TSMC plans 3-nanometer production at JASM's second Kumamoto factory, with equipment investment expected to exceed $23 billion.
claims.episode_span: TSMC plans to manufacture 3-nanometer chips at the second factory of Japan Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing
claims.source_title: TSMC Plans 3nm Chip Production At Second Japan Factory
claims.supporting_quote: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) plans to manufacture advanced semiconductors using 3-nanometre (3nm) process technology at the second factory of its Japan subsidiary, Japan Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing (JASM). The total equipment investment in the venture is expected to exceed USD 23 billion.

claims.claim: Reuters reported ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent placed more than $35 billion of Nvidia chip orders.
claims.episode_span: ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent have placed more than $35 billion worth of Nvidia chip orders.
claims.source_title: EXCLUSIVE: ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent place over $35 billion worth of Nvidia chip orders
claims.supporting_quote: EXCLUSIVE: ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent place over $35 billion worth of Nvidia chip orders

claims.claim: Fiber alignment is the main bottleneck in optical-engine test, an 8 kW GPU is hard to test beyond one die, and test connectors need to last tens of thousands or 100,000 insertions while devices are characterized beyond 200 GHz.
claims.episode_span: If the main ASIC is an 8-kilowatt GPU, with multiple connectors around multiple sides, tester resources have to deliver that power and pull the heat back out.
claims.source_title: Scaling CPO Testing Beyond A Single Die
claims.supporting_quote: Fiber alignment is the main bottleneck to optical engine testing, which would be alleviated significantly by multi-site probe cards.
